statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
